thread:
Priya R.: Hey team — pushed a clean pass of the launch post with three storyline variants + two CTA treatments: https://bit.ly/ri-post-v2 PTAL. Focus is latency/cost tradeoff + customer ROI; we need a clear webinar/demo flow.
Evan C.: on it. Quick note — can we title the webinar 'Live: Shipping LLMs at Scale' or too generic?
Diego G.: I like that title for infra folks. For product owners, Variant C (outcome-first) lands better.
Priya R.: good call. Variant A = tech intro, B = economics/ops, C = outcome-driven PM case. I've labeled sections accordingly in the doc.
Marta L.: legal quick pass incoming — few flagged words. Don't call out specific regulated sectors (e.g., "banks"). Replace with "regulated industries" and remove any HIPAA cert claims.
Priya R.: noted @Marta L. I'll update language to be generic.
Liam S.: Lead routing: plan is to tag folks who sign up with utm_campaign=launch_v2 and form hidden fields: deployment_type (Hosted/Dedicated/Private) + intent_level (demo/request_info). Route 'intent_level: demo' to SDR West pool.
Priya R.: adding hidden fields now. For the CTA copy, do we prefer 'Get started' or 'Request demo' for enterprise conversion?
Evan C.: Request demo for enterprise. Keep Get started for self-serve CTA lower in funnel.
Diego G.: also recommend adding an inline micro-case (50–75 words) under Variant B with the benchmark snapshot: "50% latency reduction, 2x throughput" — we'll link to the full benchmark pdf.
Priya R.: added the micro-case. Snippet in the post: ```Benchmark snapshot: 50% median latency reduction, 2x throughput vs baseline. See full benchmarks -> link```
Marta L.: approved once 'banks' is removed and the benchmark claim is hedged ("in our tests" or cite the benchmark doc).
Priya R.: changed to "in our internal benchmark tests" and added citation.
deploy-bot: :information_source: Reminder: publishing checklist incomplete — legal_approval field shows pending in the CMS.
Liam S.: I confirmed legal approval with @Marta L. and updated the CMS flag. HubSpot leadflow ID is LF-2026-98 (for ops). I also set form field mapping: deployment_type -> contact.property.deployment_type.
Evan C.: quick QA note: the hero image is large on mobile. Can we swap to a compressed SVG or add responsive settings + alt text?
Priya R.: swapped to compressed SVG, added alt text "diagram: request routing and cache tiers". Also embedded UTM defaults: utm_source=blog, utm_medium=organic, utm_campaign=launch_v2.
Diego G.: small nit — move the benchmark chart next to the bulleted perf list, not below the long copy. Improves scannability.
Priya R.: moved it. Updated the hero headline for Variant B per Diego's earlier suggestion, CTA text set to 'Request demo' on top rail and 'Get started' on the footer.
Marta L.: legal final: approved. No regulated sectors, claims hedged, all good.
Evan C.: product gives final okay for Variant B. Ready to schedule publish window.
Priya R.: proposed publish: Tue 10:00 AM PT. Webinar scheduled Tue 11:00 AM PT (90-minute prep window). Assigning demo ops to @Liam S. I'll open the publish ticket and mark as ready. :calendar:
Liam S.: got it — I'll own demo ops and confirm SDR rota. Sending HubSpot flow to ops channel when live.
Priya R.: Thanks everyone — final checklist: legal ✅, product ✅, design QA ✅, lead routing ✅. I'll hit publish when the CMS window opens. Will post the final live URL here once out. :tada:
